name: UAPB Library
location: University of Arkansas at Pine Bluff Campus
description: A quiet indoor space with tables, seating, and WiFi that works well for reading, assignments, and focused study sessions.

name: Student Center
description: A more social study environment that works well for meeting classmates, working on group projects, or studying between classes.

name: STEM Building
description: A good location for technical coursework, especially when working on programming assignments, math problems, or science-related projects.

name: Campus Courtyard
description: An outdoor option for students who enjoy fresh air while reading notes, reviewing flashcards, or doing lighter coursework.

name: Residence Hall Lounge
description: A convenient study option for students who want to work close to their room, especially during evenings or late-night study sessions.
